decisions.statement: A page's files are moved before that page's slug is restated.
The slug is restated at the path the move lands the page at.
The keys with a file are read from the page's own type.
A key that type does not declare is looked for among every page property.
Which properties a page type holds in a file is answered nowhere here.
A page type holding a secret or an uncommitted value keeps that value beside the page.
A file under a reserved tail is moved with the page that file sits beside.
A reserved tail with no body is moved nowhere.
A page owning its folder takes every file under that folder with the page.
Such a file keeps its place beneath the folder that page lands in.
A page in a folder named for what its slug adds keeps a folder named that way.
What the slug adds is what the folder's own name leaves off the front.
A page naming itself by what its old slug adds names itself by what the new adds.
A page naming itself otherwise keeps the name that page states.
A new slug opening otherwise lands the page in a folder named for the whole.
A page type owning its folder keeps the folder that page type has.
A file the page has already is moved once rather than a second time.
Every file the rename carries is moved by one call to the change moving many.
The type a page's file exports is spelled anew beside the const that file exports.
The name a page's code file exports from the old slug is spelled anew too.
Which name a file exports under the old slug is answered by one module.
A manifest naming a moved file as a way in states the new path for that way.
A way whose name closes with the old slug closes with the new slug instead.
A body reaching the page through the old way reaches the page through the new.
A page no manifest names as a way in leaves every manifest as that manifest is.
The modules restating an address, a slug and an export are called rather than reached.
The address a page's slug names is restated wherever a body spells that address.
The address is restated before any file the page keeps beside the page is moved.
A page type scoping its slug names that scope in the address restated.
The scope is the value the page carries under the property scoping that page type.
A scope naming its own page type is taken as the slug that name closes with.
A page carrying nothing under that property is addressed as though scoped by nothing.
A way's name is restated though the reached move restated that way's path already.
A call saying every address is restated already has no address restated here.
A call wrongly saying so leaves the addresses left out as those addresses are.
A file a page's type declares beside that page is moved though the page states no such key.
Every part of such a file that is there is moved rather than the first alone.
One module reads the files beside a page both here and in the move of a page.

definition: a page renamed and moved to where its slug says, in the data and in every name
